query_analysis.original_query: Our filtration process is struggling with cake resistance. How can we develop an advanced mathematical model to predict filtration rate considering varying cake resistance and medium properties?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a comprehensive mathematical modeling approach to predict filtration rate dynamics by incorporating complex interactions between cake resistance, filtration medium characteristics, and process parameters

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative model refinement and parameter validation
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated modeling approach with cross-domain verification
